caseName: Shattuck v. Title Guaranty & Surety Co.
caseNameFull: Frank R. Shattuck, Trustee, etc. v. The Title Guaranty & Surety Company
summary: Appeal from the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. Walter Lee Sheppard for the appellants. Mr. Frank Rogers Donahue for the appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of act of Congress, January 28, 1915, c. 22, 38 Stat. 803. See Central Trust Co. v. Lueders, 239 U. S. 11.
